subject: Budget owner identification & next steps for MitCap pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@mitcap.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps + who owns budget at MitCap?

Hi Julia —

Great to meet you and the team on today's discovery. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (from our call)
- Goal: prototype a Redwood-powered document ingestion + retrieval pipeline to accelerate MitCap analysts by Q3.
- Current infra: GCP VPCs, internal S3 buckets, custom auth; portion of workload will need to stay inside company VPC.
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in time-to-insight for analyst workflows, and a cost target that beats current inference spend per 1k requests.

Ask / next steps
1) Who owns the budget for pilots like this (econ buyer / budget owner)? If you can introduce that person it will speed approvals.
2) Procurement & security: we attached a short security_matrix_v2.xlsx and our one-pager; please share the typical procurement path (SOC2 evidence, questionnaire, legal redlines).
3) I'll circulate a brief SOW stub so finance can budget against it — attached.

Attachments: [redwood_intro_onepager.pdf (PDF)], [security_matrix_v2.xlsx (XLSX)], [SOW-stub.docx (DOCX)]

Timing: we can be flexible but suggest a 30-min intro with the budget owner + procurement next week.

If it's helpful I can include a short, non-technical 1-pager tailored for finance outlining unit economics and expected run rates.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
From: Julia Park <julia.park@mitcap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@mitcap.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + who owns budget at MitCap?

Thanks Marcus — good summary.

Brief answers:
- Budget owner for pilots like this is typically Finance — I'm going to introduce you to Danielle Ortiz (VP Finance).
- Procurement runs the security questionnaire and contract review; CC'd procurement@mitcap.com. Rajiv Kumar is the procurement lead and will coordinate the questionnaire.
- Timeline: our fiscal Q3 planning window closes mid-April; any pilot spend needs to be slotted into the Q3 forecast by 4/15.

I'm attaching a short internal timeline we use for pilot approvals. I will send an intro to Danielle + Rajiv in a separate message.

Attachment: [internal_budget_timeline.pdf (PDF)]

Julia Park
Head of Data Platforms | MitCap Technologies
julia.park@mitcap.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@mitcap.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + who owns budget at MitCap?

Perfect — appreciate the clarity and the timeline. I can prepare: (a) a 1-page finance brief with estimated monthly run-rate at a few throughput points, (b) SOC2 and security artifacts, and (c) a concise SOW showing a 6–8 week pilot scope.

Availability: I'm free Mon/Tue next week 10–12 PT for a 30-min intro.

Thanks,
Marcus
From: Julia Park <julia.park@mitcap.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@mitcap.com>, Rajiv Kumar <r.kumar@mitcap.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@mitcap.com>
Date: 2027-03-31T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Marcus from Redwood + pilot for analyst acceleration

Danielle / Rajiv — looping you both in. Marcus is leading the Redwood side; we did a discovery today and think a small pilot could help our analyst workflows.

Marcus — Danielle is VP Finance and will own budget decisions; Rajiv is procurement and will manage the questionnaire & contract flow.

Proposed 30-min windows next week: 
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 2027-04-07 11:00–11:30 PT

I've also attached a short RFP outline that summarizes scope areas we discussed (data residency, access controls, expected run rates).

Attachment: [MITCAP_RFP_outline.docx (DOCX)]

Julia

On Tue, Mar 30, 2027 at 03:12 PM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Julia —
> 
> Great to meet you and the team on today's discovery. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: ...
From: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@mitcap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@mitcap.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <r.kumar@mitcap.com>, Procurement <procurement@mitcap.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Marcus from Redwood + pilot for analyst acceleration

Marcus — thanks for the intro, Julia.

A couple quick items from finance's side before we schedule: 
1) Can you provide a ballpark monthly cost for a 3-month pilot at small scale (approx. 5 analysts, ~50k tokens/day)? A range is fine.
2) Procurement will run a security questionnaire and needs SOC2, data flow diagrams, and a sample contract (we'll accept a SOW + standard T&Cs).

Rajiv — please route the questionnaire to Redwood and let us know the expected turnaround on the SOC2 report and any encryption/KMS controls.

Assuming those items look reasonable we'll aim to slot pilot spend in Q3. Please propose two 30-min slots next week and include the finance brief you mentioned.

Thanks,
Danielle Ortiz
VP Finance | MitCap Technologies
d.ortiz@mitcap.com
Office: +1 (212) 555-0198
